meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close public hearing on LBA Capital Projects Fund Budget for FY 2021-22 and refer to public hearing on June 1, 2021
votes.description: The LBA board closed the first public hearing on the Local Building Authority Capital Projects Fund budget for FY 2021-22, which covers Glendale and Marmalade Library capital projects, and referred it to the June 1 hearing.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 2 of 2021, which permits the Local Building Authority Board of Directors to meet electronically pursuant to the Utah Open Public Meetings Act
votes.description: The LBA board adopted a resolution authorizing electronic meetings pursuant to the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.

votes.motion: Adjourn LBA and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency Board
votes.description: The Local Building Authority board adjourned its meeting and reconvened as the Redevelopment Agency board.

votes.motion: Close public hearing on RDA Budget for FY 2021-22 and refer to public hearing on June 1, 2021
votes.description: The RDA board closed the first public hearing on the Redevelopment Agency budget for FY 2021-22 and referred it to the June 1 public hearing.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Redevelopment Agency and reconvene as the City Council
votes.description: The RDA board adjourned and reconvened as the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Approve the Work Session meeting minutes of Tuesday, January 12, 2021; February 2, 2021 and February 9, 2021
votes.description: The City Council approved three prior work session meeting minutes from January and February 2021.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on Learned Alley Vacation and defer action to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed vacation of a City-owned alley adjacent to properties at 1025 West North Temple and 1022–1032 West Learned Avenue and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on Fern Subdivision Alley Vacation and defer action to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed vacation of the Fern Subdivision Alley located between 1000 East and 1100 East and between Wood Avenue and Logan Avenue, and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 9 for FY 2020-21 to June 1, 2021
votes.description: The Council continued the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 9 for FY 2020-21, which includes funding for Emergency Management office space, 911 technology upgrades, and Fire Department reimbursements, to the June 1 meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearings for items H4-H15 and refer to the public hearings on June 1, 2021
votes.description: The Council closed the first public hearings on the FY 2021-22 budget-related ordinances (H4–H15), including MOUs, compensation plans, tax levy, Library Fund budget, fee schedule amendments, and city budget, and referred them to the June 1 public hearing.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 15 of 2021, amending the FY 2020-21 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document
votes.description: The Council adopted Budget Amendment No. 8 for FY 2020-21, including funding for a lateral police officer class, Crisis Intervention Team training, a $2 million donation to Switchpoint for a senior/veteran shelter, and tentative Ranked Choice Voting funding.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 16 of 2021, amending the zoning map pertaining to the parcel at approximately 2058 North 2200 West from AG-2, Agricultural to M-1, Manufacturing
votes.description: The Council rezoned the property at 2058 North 2200 West from Agricultural (AG-2) to Light Manufacturing (M-1) to accommodate future commercial land uses.

votes.motion: Approve advice and consent of Debbie Lyons as the Director of Sustainability
votes.description: The Council confirmed the Mayor's appointment of Debbie Lyons as Director of the Sustainability Department.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 17 of 2021, granting a Master License Agreement to SQF, LLC
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance granting SQF, LLC a master license agreement to install and maintain small cell wireless infrastructure within City rights-of-way.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 18 of 2021, granting a Telecommunication Franchise Agreement to SQF, LLC
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance granting SQF, LLC a telecommunications franchise agreement allowing the company to place facilities within City rights-of-way.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 19 of 2021, approving the Amended and Restated Broadband Services Franchise agreement with Google Fiber Utah, LLC
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance approving an amended and restated broadband franchise agreement with Google Fiber Utah, LLC, removing video services, changing the fee structure, and authorizing broadband services for a 15-year term.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2021, authorizing the loan amendment from the Housing Trust Fund to Garden Lofts Holdings, LP
votes.description: The Council authorized amendments to the Housing Trust Fund loan to Garden Lofts Holdings, LP at 154 West 600 South, changing rental rates to an income-averaging approach and shifting the City's loan to third position behind a new private loan.
The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting June 8, 2021 as the public hearing date for Library Budget Amendment No. 2 for FY 2020-21.
